release.releaseNotes:
Live page padding controls on Home
• Open Home → Page padding to adjust the top gap for every app page.
• Use the 0–80 dp slider or enter a value; changes apply live and are saved.
• Tap Copy values and paste the JSON into our conversation for finalisation.
• Dialog and popup layouts keep their existing spacing.
• Final admin dashboard values and both registered-account access rules are preserved.
